Market today: The S&P 500 is being called a bargain, but the real driver for your tech/chip heavy book is likely the data center buildout news and Palantir's jump on commercial revenue. 

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -44.56% and needs attention due to its leveraged, decaying nature. SPAL is also a SELL at -49.03% for similar reasons. 

Watch: Keep an eye on Palantir (PLTR) given its recent jump and the data center news. 

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for catalysts in your sector.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its -44.56% PnL and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF with a -49.03% PnL.
PLTR: Watch for a potential entry around 162.19 with a stop at 161.25 if momentum continues.
